title: runner → studio: a run's step progress
description: Subject evt.run.<host>.<session_id>.progress (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <run_id>:<attempt>:<seq>. One per step of a stepping node (the echo node: one per step, step 1..of). A real runner adds phase (what is happening: loading transformer, encoding, sampling, decoding) and eta_s; a phase without steps of its own is sent as step 1 of 1.

node.description: the node of the run's graph that is stepping

phase.description: what the node is doing, for the UI

phase_id.description: from API 1.36: the id of one of the node's `phases` (its kind's registry nodeSchema) that it is in; only from a node that declares phases (contracts/README.md, Phases). The UI lights that phase's chip, with step/of when of > 1

eta_s.description: estimated seconds until the run finishes

attempt.description: the attempt of cmd.run.execute this event belongs to; absent = 1. seq restarts at 1 for each attempt; the projector dedupes on (job_id, attempt, seq) and drops events of an attempt that is not the run's current one
